name: Knowledge Grounding
policy: Answer product-support questions only from retrieved approved demo knowledge or clearly identified structured records.

name: No Hallucination
policy: If evidence is insufficient, say so and escalate rather than inventing facts.

name: Clinical Boundary
policy: Do not diagnose, prescribe, or alter clinical therapy.

name: Source Attribution
policy: Return the document or record used to support the answer whenever available.

name: Human Escalation
policy: Escalate unresolved, high-risk, clinical or unsupported issues.

name: Demo Data
policy: All customer records in this prototype are fictional and must not be treated as real patient information.
